Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
Jason Orman takes the first tournament, tying in VP with Ian Lee, but entering the final as higher seed.

Matthew Hatch, Bill Troxel, and Darby Keeney rounded out the field.

20 players, although each round only had 19, as we had one drop after the first round, and another join for the 2nd round.
